title: Mamma Mia!
short: Two films, the second half a prequel
blurb: An ABBA musical on a Greek island, and a sequel that splits its time between the present and 1979.

mammamia18.t: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again

note: Here We Go Again cuts between a prequel story in 1979 and a sequel in the present, so it can't be placed wholly before or after. Watch in release order.
